badRequest.title: That request didn't work
badRequest.body: Something about it was off, so nothing happened.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.body: Your account can't do this. Ask an admin for the {permission} permission.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Changes are saved locally and will sync when you reconnect.

unavailable.title: Down for a moment
unavailable.body: We're not taking requests right now. Try again shortly.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.failed: That email and password don't match.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.name: Name
signUp.terms: By continuing you agree to the {termsLink}.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.expired: That link expired. Request a new one.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor code
twoFactor.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

session.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

confirm.title: Confirm before this runs
confirm.body: Type {token} to confirm. Nothing happens until it matches.
confirm.label: Confirmation

ai.disabled: AI panes are switched off for this admin.
ai.no-runner: No AI runner is wired, so this pane has nothing to ask.

anomaly.title: Anomalies
anomaly.description: Rows that look unlike the rest of the table.

nl-query.title: Ask the data
nl-query.description: A question in plain language, answered as a read-only query.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.description: Where this series is heading, from the rows already stored.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.empty: Nothing has been done to this row yet.

not-found.fix: Go back to the list and open a row that still exists.

error.action-failed: The action threw before it finished.
error.confirmation-required: This is destructive: echo the confirmation token first.
error.invalid-input: Some fields did not pass the entity's own schema.

policy.granted: the grant list contains this permission
policy.missing: no policy is registered for this permission
policy.not-granted: the grant list does not contain this permission

skipped.forbidden: this account may not search that entity
skipped.no-text-fields: that entity has no text field to search
skipped.no-repo: that entity has no repo bound

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.question: where did the time go in this request?

live.title: Live
live.question: what does each subscriber receive, and why?

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.question: is the queue moving, and which step failed?

db.title: DB
db.question: what is in the table, and does the schema match the migrations?

mail.title: Mail
mail.question: what did that email look like, in that locale?

cache.title: Cache
cache.question: what invalidated what — and why is this still stale?

policy.title: Policy
policy.question: can this actor do that, and why?

services.title: Services
services.question: which services is this process talking to, and did anything fail to load?

boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.question: does any file import across a boundary the build will reject?

live.no-sync-node: no sync node is attached — subscriber facts need a running x dev process

cache.no-invalidations-yet: no invalidation has been logged yet — the graph above is still real
